parameters.query:
SELECT l.*, lc.day_number, lc.last_email_sent, lc.email_open_count, lc.email_click_count 
FROM leads l 
JOIN lead_campaigns lc ON l.id = lc.lead_id 
WHERE lc.campaign_type = 'drip' 
AND lc.status = 'active' 
AND lc.email_enabled = true 
AND (lc.last_email_sent IS NULL OR lc.last_email_sent < NOW() - INTERVAL '2 days') 
AND lc.day_number <= 30 
AND l.email_opt_out = false 
ORDER BY lc.priority DESC, l.lead_score DESC 
LIMIT 200

// Welcome email template const lead = $input.item.json; const htmlBody = `

🏠 Welcome ${lead.firstName}!

Your Mortgage Journey Starts Here

Thank You for Choosing Us

Hi ${lead.firstName},

Welcome to the beginning of your homeownership journey! We're excited to help you secure the perfect mortgage for your dream home.

What Happens Next:

  • Today: Your dedicated loan officer will review your application
  • Within 24 hours: You'll receive your personalized rate quote
  • Within 3 days: Document checklist and next steps
  • Within 14 days: Pre-approval (if documents are ready)

Quick Tips to Speed Up Approval:

  1. Gather your financial documents (we'll send a checklist)
  2. Check your credit report for accuracy
  3. Avoid major purchases or credit changes
  4. Respond quickly to our requests
Access Your Portal

Your Reference Number: ${lead.leadId}

Your Loan Officer: Will be assigned within 2 hours

Questions? Reply to this email or call us at ${process.env.OFFICE_PHONE}.

© 2026 Nyra Mortgage. All rights reserved.

Unsubscribe

`; return { json: { ...lead, htmlBody: htmlBody, trackingPixel: `${process.env.N8N_WEBHOOK_URL}/email-open/${lead.leadId}` } };

// Education email template const lead = $input.item.json; const htmlBody = `

📚 Your Mortgage Education

Hi ${lead.firstName},

Knowledge is power, especially when it comes to mortgages. Let's make you a mortgage expert!

💡 Today's Topic: Pre-Approval vs Pre-Qualification

Pre-Qualification: A quick estimate based on self-reported information (takes 10 minutes)

Pre-Approval: A thorough review with credit check and documentation (takes 1-3 days)

Winner: Pre-approval shows sellers you're serious and can close quickly!

Your Document Checklist:

  • ✓ Last 2 years of tax returns
  • ✓ Last 2 months of bank statements
  • ✓ Recent pay stubs (last 30 days)
  • ✓ Photo ID (driver's license or passport)
  • ✓ Proof of other income (if applicable)
Upload Documents Now

Pro tip: Having these ready can cut approval time in half!

`; return { json: { ...lead, htmlBody: htmlBody } };

// Rate update email template const lead = $input.item.json; // Calculate estimated rate based on lead score const baseRate = 6.75; const scoreAdjustment = (lead.leadScore - 50) * 0.01; const estimatedRate = (baseRate - scoreAdjustment).toFixed(3); // Calculate monthly payment const principal = lead.loanAmount; const monthlyRate = estimatedRate / 100 / 12; const numberOfPayments = 30 * 12; const monthlyPayment = (principal * monthlyRate * Math.pow(1 + monthlyRate, numberOfPayments)) / (Math.pow(1 + monthlyRate, numberOfPayments) - 1); const htmlBody = `

📊 Your Personalized Rate Quote

Hi ${lead.firstName},

Great news! Based on your profile, here's your estimated rate:

${estimatedRate}%

30-Year Fixed

Estimated Monthly Payment: $${monthlyPayment.toLocaleString('en-US', {maximumFractionDigits: 0})}

⏰ Lock This Rate Today

Rates change daily. Lock in now to secure this rate for 60 days!

Lock This Rate

Why This Rate?

  • Your credit profile: Excellent
  • Loan-to-value ratio: ${((lead.loanAmount / lead.propertyValue) * 100).toFixed(1)}%
  • Property type: ${lead.property_type || 'Primary Residence'}
`; return { json: { ...lead, htmlBody: htmlBody, estimatedRate: estimatedRate, monthlyPayment: monthlyPayment.toFixed(2) } };

parameters.query: UPDATE lead_campaigns SET last_email_sent = NOW(), email_count = email_count + 1, day_number = CASE WHEN last_email_sent < NOW() - INTERVAL '2 days' THEN day_number + 2 ELSE day_number + 1 END WHERE lead_id = $1 RETURNING *
UPDATE lead_campaigns SET email_open_count = email_open_count + 1, last_opened_at = NOW() WHERE lead_id = $1
